A small corporation on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], '''Aquatic Integrated Systems''' ('''AIS''') produced a variety of aquacultured [[Fish/Legends|fish]] and plants from the [[Elkit Peninsula]]. 

The company was owned by a group of [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]] although [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] support groups shared the 25%. It was a [[city/Legends|city]]-sized [[transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] dome that housed the whole AIS communicty of fifty thousand herglics, accomodating their biological needs and anatomy.

It was the primary producer of [[salar]] on Kothlis, a type of fish originally found only on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] but brought to [[Tal'cara]] by the company. By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the company was experimenting with cross-breeding certain [[Algae/Legends|algae]], aiming to produce a new kind of [[Foodstuff/Legends|rations]] for [[Starship/Legends|space travel]].
